proposal.explanation: The bug was that after reset deassertion, the FIFO could still serve stale data from before reset because: 1) rd_ptr reset to 0 but memory wasn't cleared, 2) empty flag used synchronized wr_ptr_gray which might not reflect post-reset writes yet, 3) output_valid_reg could become asserted based on stale empty status. The fix adds reset tracking flags (input_was_reset/output_was_reset) that suppress read operations and output valid assertion until after the first post-reset clock cycle, ensuring only fresh data is served. The input_was_reset flag is initialized to 1 and cleared on first input clock after reset. The output_was_reset flag similarly blocks reads and valid assertion until cleared on first output clock after reset.
